title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-12-09) — the year's last window, and the only one in the census whose deadline session is a half day
source: EST: the Board's own stated blackout rule applied to a meeting date re-fetched this session, and re-derived across the whole census rather than inherited. federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes) gives the 2027 panel entry 'December 7-8*' with the SEP asterisk. The blackout policy states verbatim that the window 'will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting ... if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier', and ends at the end of the Thursday following the meeting's conclusion. 2027-12-07 is a TUESDAY (computed, not assumed) so the window opens SATURDAY 2027-11-27; the meeting concludes Wednesday 2027-12-08 so it closes at the end of THURSDAY 2027-12-09. THE DERIVATION IS VALIDATED 16 OF 16 AGAINST WINDOWS THIS REPO ALREADY HOLDS: this session parsed 167 scheduled meetings from federalreserve.gov's 2021-2027 panel plus its fourteen fomchistorical<year>.htm pages 2007-2020 (HTTP 200 each, fetched direct 2026-09-08) — 21 years x 8 less the cancelled 2020-03-17/18 meeting — and ran the same arithmetic over all of them. It returns all eight 2027 windows exactly as this repo's recorded decode carries them (01-16, 03-06, 04-17, 05-29, 07-17, 09-04, 10-16, 11-27) and all eight 2026 windows exactly as three sibling ledgers carry them (09-05 to 09-17, 10-17 to 10-29, 11-28 to 12-10). This session did NOT re-run the PDF decode and does not claim to: the fomc-blackout-start-2027-04-17 lane inflated and decoded federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf on 2026-09-05 and recorded 'NOV 27 -> DEC 9' for this window, which matches this session's arithmetic to the day. Both prior proposals for this id (from-consumer-confidence-2027-11-30 and from-fomc-2027-10-27) were read before writing this file and agree to the day; nothing in either is contradicted here. Filed estimate because it is a firm rule applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date: fomccalendars.htm states verbatim 'Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it', so the promotion trigger is the 2027-10-26/27 meeting ratifying December 7-8, not a better fetch. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27 initial research (2026-09-08), which read both prior proposals first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md; they are shadowed by this file and left in place. Impact medium matches the family — every fomc-blackout-start-* entry in this calendar is medium. WHAT THIS WINDOW IS, in one line: the last of the eight 2027 gates, wrapping the year's final meeting and final SEP, and the only member of the family whose deadline session is a stock-exchange half day. THE STRUCTURAL FACT, measured across the 167-meeting census: the last session on which any FOMC participant may speak is Friday 2027-11-26, which NYSE's own hours page (fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes) states verbatim closes early at 1:00 p.m. ET as the day after Thanksgiving. Only 4 of 167 gates in 2007-2027 have that geometry, and three of them are consecutive — 2025, 2026, 2027 — against a single earlier instance in 2019. The same four are the only gates that open in November at all. December day-one has drifted earlier three years running (2025-12-09, 2026-12-08, 2027-12-07) and 2027-12-07 is the EARLIEST December day-one anywhere in the census. WHAT WAS MEASURED AND CAME BACK EMPTY, so nobody re-spends a session on it: the family's overhang premium, pooled across all 155 realized gates, is 82 above 1.0x their own month baseline (sign-test z=0.72) — not distinguishable from a coin flip; December's own is 10 of 19 (z=0.23). The release-inside-a-blackout channel is already measured null twice by the consumer-confidence lanes and is cited, not re-derived. November payrolls inside a December gate is COMMON, not distinguishing: 8 of 21 by the BLS reference-week rule (validated 4 of 4 against this calendar's own jobs-2026-* entries). WHAT IS NOT NULL, and is the deployable output: the deadline session is thin, not safe. Black Friday sessions run 0.702x their own November baseline in the MEDIAN (12 of 19 below 1.0x) but 0.958x in the MEAN, because 2021-11-26 — the one Black Friday on which news actually landed — moved the S&P 2.27% and VIX +10.04 points, the 99.6th percentile of all 5,203 daily VIX moves 2006-2026. symbols is empty, no house playbook is calendar-keyed, and nothing here licenses an entry; estimate widens caution only.
